name: Lil Uzi Vert
label: Generation Now / Atlantic
lede: A Philadelphia kid named for a machine-gun flow turns a breakup into "XO Tour Llif3," spends two years fighting a label to free Eternal Atake, and a decade on walks out independent, owning the masters.

eras.title: Francisville, then Faith
eras.text: Symere Woods grows up in North Philadelphia on Mike Jones and Meek Mill, then Marilyn Manson and Paramore. A school freestyle, a homemade group and a radio spin get the name out of the neighborhood.

years.h: Symere Woods is born in Philadelphia
years.p: Raised in Francisville, North Philadelphia. The year is 1994 or 1995: in 2021 Uzi's mother turned up a birth certificate suggesting the later one.
years.xp:
At 13 the listening turned to rock and emo: Marilyn Manson, Paramore, My Chemical Romance, the All-American Rejects. Uzi has called Manson's Mechanical Animals a favorite album.

The rapping started in tenth grade, after hearing classmate William Aston freestyle over a Chris Brown instrumental. Woods, Aston and a friend formed a group called Steaktown. People said the flow came out like a machine gun, and the name Lil Uzi Vert followed.

years.h: Purple Thoughtz Vol. 1 gets the A$AP Mob's attention
years.p: The first EP is cloud-rap phonk, with a SpaceGhostPurrp beat on "White Shit," a song that goes viral three years later.
years.xp: Before any of it, Uzi dropped out of school, quit a job at a Bottom Dollar store after four days and got kicked out of home. That is when the first face tattoo went on: the word "Faith," under the hairline, as a promise to take music seriously.

years.h: A Philadelphia radio spin brings Don Cannon, and The Real Uzi
years.p: DJ Diamond Kuts plays a song on Philadelphia radio; Don Cannon produces the mixtape and signs Uzi to his imprint, The Academy.
years.xp: The next step was a deal with Generation Now, the Atlantic imprint run by [[DJ Drama|de23d637-20df-4b15-ae63-263dd5a34f10]], Cannon and Leighton Morrison. It is the label that would put out everything through 2024, and the label Uzi would spend years fighting.

eras.title: Luv Is Rage, and a brawl in Austin
eras.text: Uzi tours with Fall Out Boy, releases a tape a season and makes the XXL Freshman cover. Then a feature on someone else's single goes to No. 1.

years.h: Fall Out Boy and Wiz Khalifa take Uzi on the Boys of Zummer tour
years.p: Uzi opens on the summer run headlined by [[Fall Out Boy|516cef4d-0718-4007-9939-f9b38af3f784]] and Wiz Khalifa. Two months later comes the second mixtape.

years.h: Luv Is Rage brings in Maaly Raw and TM88
years.p: Sonny Digital, TM88 and Maaly Raw produce, with Wiz Khalifa and [[Young Thug|800760de-bdf8-43a2-8fe0-44a2401a5515]] guesting. HotNewHipHop calls Uzi a breakout artist of 2015.

years.h: "Money Longer" premieres on Shade 45
years.p: It goes up on SoundCloud, enters the Hot 100 at No. 92 after the XXL cover and is eventually certified seven times platinum.

years.src: Wikipedia: Lil Uzi Vert · XXL: Lil Uzi Vert concert at SXSW 2016
years.h: A fight in the crowd ends Uzi's SXSW set
years.p: On the festival's last day a brawl breaks out during the show in Austin.

years.h: Lil Uzi Vert vs. the World stays on the chart 55 weeks
years.p: The first commercial mixtape debuts at No. 37 and goes double platinum. [[Metro Boomin|59db3d82-86ea-451f-881f-dffc8ec387c9]]'s "You Was Right" climbs to No. 40.

years.h: XXL's Freshman class: Uzi, Yachty, 21 Savage, Kodak
years.p: The 2016 cover also has [[Denzel Curry|5f95440d-7737-4a36-9bcf-c05337f7129b]], [[Lil Yachty|a668565b-41b8-44a8-9d5c-8e609dbf69fc]], 21 Savage and Kodak Black, Uzi's tourmate on the Parental Advisory Tour that spring.

years.h: The Perfect LUV Tape comes out on Uzi's birthday
years.p: It debuts at No. 55 and goes gold. Four months later comes 1017 vs. the World, a joint tape with Gucci Mane.

years.h: "Bad and Boujee" gives Uzi a No. 1, as a guest
years.p: The Migos single tops the Hot 100 in January 2017.

eras.title: XO Tour Llif3
eras.text: A SoundCloud upload with a beat made on a Bluetooth speaker becomes the song of the year, and the album it was supposed to preview gets stuck. Uzi says so, loudly.

yt: XO Tour Llif3, official video directed by Virgil Abloh
years.h: "XO Tour Llif3" goes up on SoundCloud
years.p: TM88 made the beat on a Beats Pill speaker during airport delays. It peaks at No. 7 and becomes Uzi's first Diamond single.
years.xp:
Recorded in January and inspired by Uzi's breakup with designer Brittany Byrd, the song is about leaning on Xanax and pills to get through heartbreak. TM88 had lost his laptop charger in the delays after the Fort Lauderdale airport shooting, so he made the beat in FL Studio on a Beats Pill.

The official video, directed by Virgil Abloh in Paris's 10th arrondissement with cameos from [[The Weeknd|c8b03190-306c-4120-bb0b-6f2ebfc06ea9]] and Nav, arrived September 4. The RIAA certified it 14 times platinum in December 2024.

years.h: Luv Is Rage 1.5 comes out on tour with The Weeknd
years.p: Kingdom Hearts beats, anime and Steven Universe references, and the first songs that get Uzi called an emo rapper.

years.h: Uzi blames DJ Drama for the Luv Is Rage 2 delay
years.p: A week later Don Cannon says the album won't be out any time soon, though "XO Tour Llif3" will be on it.

years.h: Uzi and Playboi Carti share Coachella
years.p: They perform "Wokeuplikethis," their song on [[Playboi Carti|2baf3276-ed6a-4349-8d2e-f4601e7b2167]]'s mixtape, released April 7. Later that year the 16*29 tour together is announced, then cancelled when Uzi says he needs to focus.

years.h: Luv Is Rage 2 drops at midnight and debuts at No. 1
years.p: Announced the day before, it does 135,000 units and puts ten songs on the Hot 100.
years.xp: "The Way Life Goes" and "Sauce It Up" became the singles. A remix of "The Way Life Goes" with [[Nicki Minaj|1036b808-f58c-4a3e-b461-a2c4492ecf1b]] reached No. 24, and Uzi performed it on The Late Show in February 2018. The year also brought a Best New Artist nomination at the 2018 Grammys.

years.cap: Uzi at Day N Night Festival, Anaheim, August 2017
years.h: Song of Summer at the VMAs, then a medley inside Ed Sheeran's set
years.p: "XO Tour Llif3" wins the award, and Uzi joins [[Ed Sheeran|b8a7c51f-362c-4dcb-a259-bc6e0095f0a6]] to mash it into "Shape of You."

eras.title: Free Uzi
eras.text: The next album is named and finished, and then held. Uzi quits music on Instagram, signs with Roc Nation management, while finished songs keep leaking anyway.

years.h: A $20,000 offer turns into a feud with Rich the Kid
years.p: Rich offers Uzi a Rich Forever deal, Uzi scoffs at the money, Rich answers with the diss "Dead Friends," and in June security stops Uzi going after him at a Starbucks.

years.src: Complex: The long road to Lil Uzi Vert's Eternal Atake · Wikipedia: Eternal Atake
years.h: Uzi names the album, and a cult objects to the cover
years.p: Uzi explains the title on Twitter. The art, posted July 31, borrows from Heaven's Gate, and the group's two survivors call it infringement.
years.xp: On August 3 the Heaven's Gate survivors said Uzi was using and adapting their copyrights and trademarks without permission. No legal action followed. In March 2020 Uzi put alternative covers up for a fan vote on Twitter.

years.cap: Uzi on stage in Auckland, February 2018
years.src: Complex: The long road to Lil Uzi Vert's Eternal Atake · PhillyVoice: Lil Uzi Vert wants to renegotiate
years.h: At a Philadelphia show, Uzi says the album is done
years.p: Eternal Atake is finished, Uzi tells the hometown crowd. It will take 15 more months to come out.

q: I'm done with Music. I deleted everything.
years.src: Complex: The long road to Lil Uzi Vert's Eternal Atake · Wikipedia: Eternal Atake
years.h: Uzi quits music on Instagram
years.p: Two days later, on Instagram Live, Uzi hints the label is the problem. Many took the retirement for a stunt.

years.src: Complex: The long road to Lil Uzi Vert's Eternal Atake · PhillyVoice: Lil Uzi Vert wants to renegotiate
years.h: Roc Nation takes over management, and "Free Uzi" appears
years.p: Uzi posts the song to SoundCloud and Tidal on March 28. Atlantic calls it a leak, and an uncleared sample gets it pulled.
years.xp:
Days earlier, DJ Drama had posted that Uzi "should put EA out tomorrow or any day he wants." TMZ then reported Uzi wanted the contract renegotiated, and PhillyVoice summed up the complaint: Uzi felt "financially and artistically exploited," and had borrowed from friends for studio time.

Producer Brandon Finessin said in April that there were eleven different versions of Eternal Atake.

years.src: XXL: Lil Uzi Vert runs away from Nardwuar
years.h: Nardwuar gets an air freshener in, then Uzi bolts
years.p: After a Rolling Loud Miami set, Uzi runs from Nardwuar like he's in a marathon, XXL wrote, and only answers the sign-off from the car.
years.xp: It was round two. In December 2018 Uzi had cut a Nardwuar interview short. This time Nardwuar did get one fact confirmed before the sprint: Uzi's DJ, Pete for Real, is the son of Prince Paul. The same day, Uzi told the crowd the last song for the album was finished.

years.src: Complex: The long road to Lil Uzi Vert's Eternal Atake · Wikipedia: Lil Uzi Vert
years.h: "Futsal Shuffle 2020" debuts at No. 5
years.p: It is Uzi's highest debut as a lead artist and the confirmed lead single. Five days later Uzi promises to flood 2020.

eras.title: Baby Pluto lands
eras.text: Eternal Atake comes out a week early and does what everyone in the fight said it would. A Future collaboration and a $24 million forehead follow.

years.h: Eternal Atake arrives a week ahead of schedule
years.p: It debuts at No. 1 with 288,000 units and 400 million US streams. [[Syd|7d3d6c65-e053-4657-8705-0ca61bc012ad]] is the only guest.
years.xp:
Eighteen tracks in three parts: Baby Pluto, then Renji, then Uzi. The theme is an alien abduction, recorded from 2018 to 2020 at Jungle City in New York, Milkboy in Philadelphia and NRG in North Hollywood. Metacritic: 84.

The deluxe, Lil Uzi Vert vs. the World 2, came on March 13 with 14 new songs, guests including [[Chief Keef|9118f524-be76-4eaf-875c-ccf15e2a2ad6]], 21 Savage, [[Future|48262e82-db9f-4a92-b650-dfef979b73ec]], Young Thug and Lil Durk, and kept the album at No. 1.

years.h: Future and Uzi make Pluto x Baby Pluto
years.p: "Patek" and "Over Your Head" came out on Uzi's birthday in July. The album peaks at No. 2.

years.h: Uzi gets a pink diamond implanted in the forehead
years.p: Ten carats from jeweler Elliot Eliantte, valued at $24 million, inspired by Steven Universe and Lil B.
years.xp: Uzi said removing it the wrong way could be fatal. It came out in June, went back in for Rolling Loud in July, and was ripped out by fans while Uzi crowd surfed, without serious injury. A barbell piercing sits there now.

years.h: A confrontation with Saint Jhn ends in a no-contest plea
years.p: Uzi pulled a gun on Saint Jhn and ex-girlfriend Brittany Byrd after seeing them together. In February 2022 Uzi pleaded no contest to felony assault with a firearm.
years.xp: No one was hurt that night, per Wikipedia. The plea deal, as TMZ reported it: three years of formal probation, a year of mental health and substance treatment, 52 weeks of domestic violence counseling and a ten-year protective order.

eras.title: Just wanna rock, then go it alone
eras.text: A jersey-club single and a rock album with Bring Me the Horizon take Uzi to WrestleMania and back to No. 1. After Eternal Atake 2, Uzi goes independent.

years.h: "Just Wanna Rock" takes jersey club to No. 10
years.p: Synthetic and MCVertt produce it, it blows up on TikTok, and it is Uzi's highest-charting single since Eternal Atake.

years.src: Wrestling Inc.: Lil Uzi Vert brings the Usos · ABC Audio: Lil Uzi Vert wanted to get in the ring
yt: Lil Uzi Vert live at WrestleMania 39
years.h: Uzi plays "Just Wanna Rock" at WrestleMania 39
years.p: Uzi walks The Usos to the ring, and afterward admits wanting to get in it.

years.cap: Pink Tape Tour, PNC Arena, Raleigh, November 2023
years.src: Wikipedia: Pink Tape (Lil Uzi Vert album) · Wikipedia: Lil Uzi Vert
years.h: Pink Tape covers System of a Down and hits No. 1
years.p: Twenty-six songs, 87 minutes, with [[Bring Me the Horizon|074e3847-f67f-49f9-81f1-8c8cea147e8e]], Babymetal, [[Travis Scott|e4a51f17-a57b-47b1-b37b-f552d0f8e9e6]] and Nicki Minaj. It debuts with 167,000 units.
years.xp:
Announced on Instagram in July 2021 for a Halloween release that slipped by two years. The cover of System of a Down's "Aerials" carries credits for [[Rick Rubin|07aebfa0-55d6-47e0-a284-12330e3eae0d]], Serj Tankian and Daron Malakian. Third studio album, third No. 1: Wikipedia says only [[Drake|9fff2f8a-21e6-47de-a2b8-7f449929d43f]] and J. Cole had done that this century in hip-hop.

Reviews were mixed (Metacritic 64). Clash praised its "stunning creativity"; Pitchfork called it "bloated and messy."

years.h: Barter 16 leaks and gets scrapped
years.p: Uzi had promised the mixtape if Pink Tape went No. 1, and teased Young Thug-inspired art three days earlier. Then the songs leaked.

years.h: Eternal Atake 2 brings Big Time Rush and Charlie Puth
years.p: Cashmere Cat and Brandon Finessin lead the production. It debuts at No. 3, behind Tyler, the Creator and Sabrina Carpenter.
years.xp: First week: 59,000 units, which Billboard noted was the lowest of Uzi's career. Big Time Rush is the only guest, on "The Rush." Metacritic: 48.

years.src: PR Newswire: Lil Uzi Vert marks new career chapter
years.h: Uzi goes independent with Roc Nation and keeps the masters
years.p: "Chanel Boy" is the first release. Only Jay-Z and Rihanna had been managed by Roc Nation while on its distribution arm, the company said.

years.src: Complex: Lil Uzi Vert drops surprise birthday EP
years.h: A surprise birthday EP, the same night as a Lollapalooza no-show
years.p: Eight songs, with baby Uzi and grandmother on the cover. In Chicago, the announcement blamed "travel complications of the Uzi Bird."
years.xp: NBC Chicago pointed to heavy rain and storms around the city. [[Zara Larsson|134e6410-6954-45d1-bd4a-0f2d2ad5471d]] took the slot. Complex noted the date's history: The Perfect LUV Tape in 2016 and the two Future singles in 2020 also came out on July 31.
